details: This is a purely automated morphing gallery with zero user interaction handlers (no brush, zoom, drag, click, or touch events), so update storms, feedback loops, stale closures, and mouse-touch conflicts are all moot. The only minor concern is the absence of .interrupt() before each loopMorph transition, which is a best-practice guard even in automated loops, but carries no practical risk here since no external event can inject a competing transition.
